definitions.explanation: An alphanumeric code that identifies a specific model or version of a product. Essential for ordering replacement parts, comparing products, or seeking support.

examples.japanese: {型番|かたばん}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
この{製品|せいひん}の{型番|かたばん}は{裏面|うらめん}に{書|か}いてあります。
examples.english: The model number for this product is written on the back.

examples.japanese: {修理|しゅうり}を{依頼|いらい}する{際|さい}は、{型番|かたばん}と{製造|せいぞう}{番号|ばんごう}をお{伝|つた}えください。
examples.english: When requesting a repair, please provide the model number and serial number.

notes:
Composed of {型|かた} (model, type) + {番|ばん} (number). A practical term used in retail, manufacturing, and customer service. Knowing the {型番|かたばん} is essential when buying replacement parts, getting repairs, or comparing product specifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {型番|かたばん}を{調|しら}べる: to look up the model number
- {型番|かたばん}を{確認|かくにん}する: to verify the model number
- {型番|かたばん}{検索|けんさく}: model number search
- {旧|きゅう}{型番|かたばん}: old model number

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {品番|ひんばん}: product number — used more in retail and inventory contexts
- {製造|せいぞう}{番号|ばんごう}: serial number — unique to each individual unit, unlike {型番|かたばん} which is shared across all units of the same model
- {型式|かたしき}: model type — a more formal/technical designation, common in automotive contexts
